questions.help: 7 Seat belts     7.1 Purpose and effectivenessIn addition, the seat belt keeps the person inside the protective cell.(Many people are killed each year when they are catapulted from their vehicle having not worn a seat belt). The seat belt is useful for all kinds of collisions however, not just front impacts.With the use of seat belt, deaths caused by road traffic collisions have dropped significantly. It is estimated that by being properly secured in a vehicle there is a reduction, of nearly a half, of the likelihood of being killed in a road traffic collision.To be effective, the seat belt should be approved. In addition, it must be well anchored. The anchorage points and the fastening device (buckle) should be checked regularly and repairs should be undertaken if necessary.The condition of the belt fabric should also be inspected, to ensure that it is not worn, cut or has frayed edges. Por encima del hombro.
Above the shoulder.

Sobre la clavícula y por el centro del pecho.
Over your collarbone and the middle of your chest.

Por los huesos de la cadera.
Over your hip bones.

questions.help: 7 Seat belts 7.4 The correct fastening of seat beltsThe belt (chest down)The belt must pass on the collar bone, (clavicle) that is midway between the shoulder and neck, and must descend through the centre of the chest.It should be applied correctly and adjustments should be made either to the seat or height of the belt to ensure this. Wrongly adjusted or located it can cause serious injury in the event of an accident. If it is placed onto the shoulder, it could slide of in a collision and minimise the effectiveness of the seat belt.(Página 77 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
¿Por dónde debe pasar la cinta torácica del cinturón de seguridad?
Where should the upper portion of your seatbelt cover?

answers.text:
sobre los huesos de la cadera o sobre el abdomen.
over the hip bones or over the abdomen.

sobre el abdomen, únicamente.
only over the abdomen.

sobre los huesos de la cadera, siempre por debajo del abdomen.
over the hip bones, always under the abdomen.

questions.help: 7 Seat belts   7.4 The correct fastening of seat beltsThe belt (abdominal)The abdominal part of the belt should be placed on the bones of the hip, always below the waist. If it is placed on the abdomen it could cause serious internal injuries in the event of a collision.Once buckled, the belt should stretch slightly upwards and be tight to the body. Check that is not hooked or twisted at any point.(Página 77 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
La cinta abdominal del cinturón de seguridad debe colocarse...
The abdominal seat belt must be placed...

answers.text:
es peligroso, porque reduce la eficacia del cinturón.
s dangerous, because it reduces the seat belt's effectiveness.

es necesario, como complemento del airbag, en los vehículos dotados del mismo.
s necessary to complement the airbag in vehicles equipped with an airbag.

es conveniente, porque reduce la presión del cinturón sobre el pecho.
is practical because it reduces the belt's pressure on your chest.

questions.help: 7 Seat belts 7.4 The correct fastening of seat beltsThe seat belt must be properly secured (buckled-up) and adjusted correctly so that it is neither too loose nor too tight for comfortable travel.If the seat belt is slack the body travels a greater distance during an impact and is more likely to be hit against the steering wheel or windshield.If seatbelts are not snugly fastened, the seatbelt loses effectiveness and can lead to injuries in accidents.The use of seat belt locking clips or tension adjusters is prohibited and dangerous, because it reduces the effectiveness of the seat belt.(Página 77 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
Utilizar pinzas para retener el cinturón de seguridad...
Using clips to retain the seat belt...

answers.text:
No, el cinturón es efectivo siempre.
No, the seat belt always works properly.

Sí, ya que se pueden sufrir lesiones graves.
Yes, as serious injuries may occur.

No, cuando el vehículo tenga además instalado airbag.
No, if the vehicle has an airbag installed.

questions.question:
Si no lleva colocado correctamente el cinturón de seguridad, ¿puede influir en las consecuencias de un accidente?
If you do not wear a seat belt correctly, can this influence the consequences of an accident?

answers.text:
Sí, para no tener frío y, además, en caso de accidente protege al ocupante.
Yes, to avoid being cold and, in addition, in the event of an accident, it protects the occupant.

No, ya que en caso de accidente reduce la eficacia del cinturón de seguridad y del pretensor.
No, as in the event of an accident it reduces the effectiveness of the seat belt and the pretensioner.

Sí, para no tener sensación de frío, que puede hacer que nos distraigamos.
Yes, to avoid feeling cold, which can make us distracted.
